scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path dsp/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p web/src/dsp && cp dsp/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dsp.wasm web/src/dsp/dsp.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path dsp/Cargo.toml --release && npm run build:wasm && node --test test/*.test.mjs
